scope: Browser only. No server/broker changes, restarts or push.

method.browser: Existing muxpad Chromium connected over CDP; no launched browser.
method.live: Shipping app on loopback; PerformanceObserver longtask/paint, Resource Timing, CDP heap/DOM counters and sampling CPU profiler.
method.functions: Production Vite build in /tmp, minify=false, temporary transform wrapping selected functions with performance.now() counters; isolated loopback preview against the real backend.
method.switches: Navigation to paint of the active mounted view, timed entirely in the page with requestAnimationFrame; excludes automation click/actionability latency. Does not require complete transcript history.
method.first_transcript: HTTP cache disabled, new page, MutationObserver detects the first visible .chat-turn and records the next animation frame. Separate from first-contentful-paint.
method.controlled_publish: 30 flushSync corpus publishes with identical row values but new corpus array identities; four mounted chats; final restoration publish included in call counts.
method.race: Intercept the real /api/tabs/all response, delay delivery 300ms, allow sidebar requests/pushes to land. Only the all-tabs implementation differs in before/after builds.
method.limits: Live accounts and concurrent coding work changed during sampling. Whole-session timings and long-task totals are observations, not a controlled overall speedup. Function totals are inclusive and must not be added together.

ranked_findings.name: Duplicate initial corpus requests
ranked_findings.risk: Medium: ordered replay must preserve newer rows, removals and report text. Status/gap/overflow backstops still refetch. Journal capped at 4096.

ranked_findings.name: Transcript/corpus render fanout
ranked_findings.risk: Low with immutable published corpora. WeakMap does not retain dead corpus keys. Completion membership still invalidates voice processing; report/chip metadata remains reactive.

ranked_findings.name: Serialized corpus equality on poll landings
ranked_findings.risk: Low: compares JSON wire values directly, retains fill quantization, ignores key insertion order and omitted undefined fields.

ranked_findings.name: Hidden chats rerender during navigation
ranked_findings.risk: Low: default React.memo over primitive props. Props, local state and context remain reactive. No demonstrated improvement to overall switching latency.

retention_after_visits.interpretation: Retained chats/terminals/embedded documents, not evidence of a GC leak. Visited workspace/tab sets have no eviction limit.

remaining_hazards: One non-passive document capture wheel handler per XtermPane; removed on cleanup, but dispatch fans out across mounted terminals.
Mounted visited workspace/tab hosts have no eviction policy; hidden chat sockets/state remain live.
SwipeRow has one module-store subscription per row, cleaned up on unmount. Its global scroll listener is installed only while that row is open.
CardsView 30s and ChatPane spawn-rounds 60s timers lack document-hidden gating.
tab-detail-prime Map removes entries only when taken; TTL does not evict never-opened creations.
No reproducible infinite effect loop or accumulating listener leak found in inspected paths.

sabotage.equality: 3 tests fail when JSON signatures restored
sabotage.projection: 2 tests fail when WeakMap lookup bypassed
sabotage.voice_membership: 1 integration test fails with unstable Set restored
sabotage.memo: 1 integration test fails with memo replaced by identity wrapper

validation.typecheck: pnpm -s typecheck passed after concurrent unread fixture was corrected

long_task_observations.interpretation: Different live-update windows; not a controlled reduction attributable solely to these fixes.

ranked_next_steps.step: Measure and shorten the critical path to the first visible transcript after the combined build is served.
ranked_next_steps.why: The 5.29s load had zero browser long tasks, with /api/boot waiting 2.21s and tab detail 1.15s. Repeat with fixed chat, workload and cache policy before claiming a user-visible improvement.

ranked_next_steps.step: Measure and bound or pause retained hidden views; consolidate terminal wheel capture.
ranked_next_steps.why: Post-GC heap grew from 13.2 to 26.6 MB and JS event listeners from 369 to 593 after visits. Visited chats have no eviction policy. Each terminal installs a non-passive document capture wheel listener. Preserve drafts, scroll position and reconnect recovery; retention alone does not prove a leak.

ranked_next_steps.step: Profile remaining transcript rendering and streaming before changing callbacks, context boundaries or per-event voice projections.
ranked_next_steps.why: The final 15-second update window still caused 90 ChatPane renders while voice-pipeline reruns were zero. Child-list callback identity, mention context and voice cloning on real transcript changes remain candidates.

ranked_next_steps.step: Clean up hidden-document polling and expired, never-consumed primed tab details.
ranked_next_steps.why: CardsView and spawn-rounds timers lack document-hidden gating. tab-detail-prime removes entries on consumption rather than on expiry. These are lower-priority lifetime issues, without a demonstrated contribution to the switching complaint.

why_work_stopped: The measured top fixes and structural-corpus integration were completed. Remaining work needs attribution after the combined deployment or changes deliberate keep-alive behavior. No comparable first-paint improvement was established; 115ms to 112ms warm-switch medians are within noise.

deployment.verified_serving_behavior: server/src/static-assets.ts reads index.html and /api/build fresh per request and serves assets from the web root. Rebuilding the served web bundle does not require remounting static routes.
deployment.scope: Parallel server changes have their own restart requirements; this statement covers the five browser performance commits only.
